items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: You take like, uh, Louis Demain, he was a good man.

ctx.x: Some of them we'll never know about that cause they died without ever making a record. That's true.

You take, you take like, uh, like, uh, Willie Edward, he's a good trumpet player. You take like, uh, Louis Demain, he was a good man. Amos Ryder, he was a good man. George McCullen, he was a good man. All them was good, all them was really good, good trumpet players. Were they hot trumpet players? Oh, yeah, but they was, they was musical man. Oh, they could, they could play that Dixieland music. Oh, yeah. Yeah, they could play it.
Could they play it like Buddy? Buddy?
